master.definition_en: Formation or presence of a blood clot (thrombus) in the superior sagittal sinus or the inferior sagittal sinus. Sagittal sinus thrombosis can result from infections, hematological disorders, craniocerebral trauma; and neurosurgical procedures. Clinical features are primarily related to the increased intracranial pressure causing headache; nausea; and vomiting. Severe cases can evolve to seizures or coma.

master.definition_en: A neoplasm of lymphoblasts committed to the T-cell lineage, typically composed of small to medium-sized blast cells. When it involves nodal or extranodal sites it is called T lymphoblastic lymphoma. (WHO, 2001)

mechanisms: Granulocyte colony stimulating factor receptor agonist

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 典型‘时间就是心肌、时间就是生命’超急性急症：冠状动脉粥样硬化斑块破裂继发血栓急性完全（STEMI）或不完全（NSTEMI）闭塞，导致心肌缺血坏死，院外极早期（发病1小时内）极易因室颤等恶性心律失常猝死，随后数小时至数天内可并发心源性休克、心脏破裂或急性肺水肿死亡；发病120分钟内再灌注效果最佳。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 胸痛中心绿色通道急诊PCI或溶栓可快速开通梗死相关动脉挽救濒死心肌，大幅降低院内死亡率；心肌一旦坏死不可再生，需终生双联抗血小板、强化降脂及心室重构逆转治疗。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 立即嚼服阿司匹林300mg + P2Y12抑制剂负荷量（替格瑞洛180mg或氯吡格雷300–600mg）并完成12导联心电图（10分钟内）；STEMI目标‘入门到导丝通过（D-to-W）≤90分钟’行急诊直接PCI，无法在120分钟内行PCI者若无禁忌立即于30分钟内静脉溶栓（阿替普酶或替奈普酶）并转运行药物-介入策略；合并心室颤动立即电除颤。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 超长效RNAi降脂药物英克司兰钠（Inclisiran）实现了‘半年一针’稳定降LDL-C并于2026年执行中国常规药品保障新价2,790元/针；靶向脂蛋白(a)的siRNA药物Lepodisiran（2期ALPACA试验2025年公布400mg降Lp(a)近94%）和Olpasiran（3期）正在验证降低极高危心梗患者残余心血管风险；同时体内CRISPR碱基编辑药物VERVE-102（Heart-2 1b期，2025）单次输注降低PCSK9达88%、LDL-C达62%，为早发冠心病/心梗带来‘一次性基因降脂’前景。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）院前延误严重，大量STEMI患者在呼叫急救前发生院外室颤猝死；2）大面积梗死后缺血再灌注损伤及心肌瘢痕尚无再生修复药物；3）基层农村地区90分钟内转运PCI网络覆盖仍不均衡。

master.definition_en: Fixed subaortic stenosis (FSS) is a rare heart malformation characterized by the obstruction by membranous or fibromuscular tissue of the left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) below the aortic valve, that occurs as an isolated lesion or in association with additional cardiac malformations (e.g. ventricular septal defect, patent ductus arteriosus, coarctation of the aorta), that presents in childhood with signs of LVOT obstruction (e.g. dyspnea, chest pain, syncope, palpitations) and that can potentially lead to life-threatening complications (e.g. aortic regurgitation, infective endocarditis). It comprises three anatomical subforms: discrete fixed membranous subaortic stenosis (membranous tissue encircling the LVOT), discrete fibromuscular subaortic stenosis (fibromuscular tissue encircling the LVOT) and tunnel subaortic stenosis (fibromuscular diffuse tunnel-like narrowing of the LVOT), the two latter forms being generally more severe than the membranous form.

master.name_en: mitochondrial complex II deficiency, nuclear type 1
master.definition_en: Complex II deficiency is a mitochondrial disease. Mitochondria are specialized compartments in cells that create more than 90% of the energy needed by the body. In mitochondrial diseases, the mitochondria don't work correctly resulting in less energy in the cell, cell injury and cell death. The signs and symptoms of mitochondrial complex II deficiency can vary greatly from severe life-threatening symptoms in infancy to muscle disease beginning in adulthood. Complex II deficiency can be caused by mutations in the SDHA, SDHB, SDHD, or SDHAF1 genes. In many cases the underlying gene mutations cannot be identified. Complex II deficiency is inherited in an autosomal recessive fashion. Complex II deficiency gene mutation carriers may be at an increased risk for certain cancers.

master.definition_en: Any hereditary disease in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the NUS1 gene. Biallelic variants cause a congenital disorder of glycosylation. Heterozygous variants, including deletions, cause a complex neurological disorder with developmental delay, intellectual disability, epilepsy including developmental and epileptic encephalopathy and progressive myoclonus epilepsy, and movement disorders including myoclonus, dystonia, ataxia, tremor and parkinsonism. Rare NUS1 variants have also been associated with Parkinson's disease.

master.definition_en: A rare systemic condition affecting neonates born at less than 37 weeks gestational age and characterized by life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to an infection, which may have been acquired shortly before or during birth (resulting in early-onset neonatal sepsis during the first 72 hours of life), or after birth (leading to late-onset neonatal sepsis between 72 hours and three months). Prematurity constitutes one of the primary risk factors for neonatal sepsis. The clinical picture may develop gradually with signs and symptoms like irritability, lethargy, or poor feeding, or progress rapidly to respiratory distress, fever, hypothermia, hypotension, shock, and multiple organ failure.

master.definition_en: A group of rare disorders comprises dentinogenesis imperfecta and dentin dysplasia characterized by abnormal dentin structure affecting either the primary or both the primary and secondary dentitions. Clinically, the teeth are discolored and exhibit structural defects, such as bulbous crowns and small pulp chambers on radiographs. The underlying mineralization defect often results in shearing of the overlying enamel, leaving weakened dentin exposed and prone to wear.
